requirements.title: CI Visibility Matrix
requirements.description: The matrix defines the visibility of configuration items (CIs) based on the offering type and target managed by. The matrix must ensure that CIs are visible or hidden according to the defined rules.
requirements.user_story: As a system administrator, I want to access a CI visibility matrix that defines the visibility of configuration items based on the offering type and target managed by, so that I can ensure that CIs are visible or hidden according to our rules.
acceptance_criteria: The matrix must define the visibility of CIs based on the offering type and target managed by.

test_steps.expected_result: The matrix is displayed with the correct visibility rules for CIs.

requirements.description: The process workflows include standard selection, redirected selection, and external sync. The workflows must ensure that the correct processes are followed for each scenario.
requirements.user_story: As a system administrator, I want to follow the defined process workflows for MACD, so that I can ensure that the correct processes are followed for each scenario.
acceptance_criteria: The workflows must include standard selection, redirected selection, and external sync.

test_steps.expected_result: The workflow is completed correctly and the form is populated.
